content_sections.heading: BRLPS MIS Consultant (ERP) at a Glance

rows.details: Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (BRLPS / JEEVIKA)
Up to a maximum of 11 months in a year (contract basis, extendable)
Rs. 55,000/- per month (A5 category of Consultant Policy)
55 years for all other candidates; upper age limit of 61 years for Government/PSU/Bank Retired employees

rows.essential_qualification: MCA / M.Sc. IT / B.Tech in IT/CS with minimum 3 years of Post-Qualification Experience in development and roll out of ERP.
rows.desirable: Experience working in Odoo. Experience in developing modules like HR, Accounting, Inventory, Procurement, PoS, etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected MIS Consultant (ERP) will receive a consolidated honorarium of Rs. 55,000/- per month under the A5 category of the Consultant Policy. Full-time consultants are eligible for one day Casual Leave (CL) in a month, and female consultants are eligible for up to two days Special Leave (SL) in a month. The engagement is for up to a maximum of 11 months in a year, which may be extended further based on work requirements and the approval of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BRLPS MIS Consultant (ERP)
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at brlps.in and navigate to the "Career" section to apply online. Fill out the Online Application Form with correct and complete information. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- online during registration. Submit the application form before the last date of 21/10/2026. Keep a printout of the online application form, 5 copies of your resume, 2 copies of identical coloured passport-size photographs, and all required certificates for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of two stages. Stage 1 involves the shortlisting of candidates based on minimum qualifications and relevant experience. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to Stage 2, which consists of a Personal Interview carrying full marks of 50. The minimum qualifying marks are 50% for UR and 45% for EBC. The final result will be declared based on marks obtained in the Personal Interview.

rows.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

faq.question: Q1. Is this BRLPS MIS Consultant (ERP) post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is on a full-time contract basis for up to a maximum of 11 months in a year, which may be extended further based on work requirements and competent authority approval.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation or what are the age limits?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years for all other candidates, with an upper age limit of 61 years applicable specifically for Government, PSU, and Bank retired employees. Reservation is applicable as per the latest Reservation Policy of the Government of Bihar exclusively for Bihar domicile candidates.

faq.question: Q3. Can retired government or PSU employees apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, Government, PSU, and Bank retired employees can apply, subject to an upper age limit of 61 years.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the personal interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates is based strictly on the eligibility criteria, minimum qualifications, and post-qualification relevant experience provided in the online application form.

faq.question: Q5. What are the desirable qualifications mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: Preference is given to candidates who have experience working in Odoo and experience in developing modules such as HR, Accounting, Inventory, Procurement, and PoS.
